ABOUT US

SPM EQUIPMENT

Oil and Gas Pipeline Equipment Manufacturer

SPM EQUIPMENT is a India based company that has extensive experience in the manufacturing and supply of high-quality Oil and Gas pipeline equipment to their customers worldwide. Our range of products includes Main Line Pipe Joint Clamps, DSS Welding Equipment with Purge Chamber, Pipe Lowering & Lifting Equipment, Pipe Roller & Rotator, Cold Pipe Bending Equipment, Pipe Cutting & Line Pipe Plant Equipment, Pipe Coating Equipment and other Pipeline Construction Equipments.

About SPM

SPM EQUIPMENT is a India based company that has extensive experience in the manufacturing and supply of high-quality Oil and Gas pipeline equipment to customers worldwide. Our range of products includes Main Line Pipe Joint Clamps, DSS Welding Equipment with Purge Chamber, Pipe Lowering & Lifting Equipment, Pipe Roller & Rotator, Cold Pipe Bending Equipment, Pipe Cutting & Line Pipe Plant Equipment, Pipe Coating Equipment and other Engineering Components.

 

Exports

We manufacture and export products globally, including in Russia, USA, UAE, Australia, Malaysia, France, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, Tanzania, Switzerland, Qatar, South Korea, Bangladesh, Czech Republic, The Netherlands, Kazakhstan, Mongolia, Nigeria, Vietnam, Oman, Thailand, Mexico, Papua New Guinea, Tunisia and many other countries.
